title: Single hieratic sign, Paris, Bibliothèque Nationale de France, Egyptien 183 (AKU HT 17463)

object.name: Paris, Bibliothèque Nationale de France, Egyptien 183

source.attribution: Facsimile by Simone Gerhards; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 17463

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 17463; AKU grapheme F0640 (AKU GR 250). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: F51 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 177, 178. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 16, no. 178. Occurrence: line 9; find place Theben West; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 7.8 x 7.3 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Mittleres Reich, 12. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Simone Gerhards. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
